rounds.fact: BBC Online launched in 1997 and was one of the first major broadcasters to build a genuinely large-scale news website, well ahead of most American networks doing the same.
Tumblr popularized the short-form 'microblogging' format, and grew so fast in its early years that it regularly had to fight off downtime from its own success.
Download.com (run by CNET) was one of the main places people got shareware and freeware software in the pre-app-store era, complete with user ratings and virus scanning.
Airbnb started in 2008 with the founders renting out air mattresses in their own apartment during a design conference, which is where the original name came from.
Barnes & Noble launched bn.com in 1997 specifically to compete with Amazon, one of the first major traditional retailers to take online bookselling seriously.
